      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,

      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns),0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns),0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns),0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns) THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns),0) END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,

    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((local_day <> '' AND local_day >= ? AND local_day < ?) OR local_day = '') UNION ALL SELECT provider, project_key, session_id,
    coalesce(agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, 'day'), '') AS local_day,
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,

    coalesce(SUM(cache_write_input_tokens),0) AS cache_write_input_tokens,

    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN output_tokens END),0) AS c_output_tokens,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_tokens END),0) AS c_total_tokens,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens,

    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END),0) AS r_output_tokens,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END),0) AS r_total_tokens,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS r_duration_ms,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS r_duration_ms_known,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,
    MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) AND (started_at_ms < ? OR started_at_ms >= ?) GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day) AS turn_summary
        GROUP BY provider,period ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider,period LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,
    MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) AND (started_at_ms < ? OR started_at_ms >= ?) GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day, model_key) AS turn_summary GROUP BY provider,model,period)

    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
    coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS r_duration_ms,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS r_duration_ms_known,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,
    MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) AND (started_at_ms < ? OR started_at_ms >= ?) GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day, model_key) AS turn_summary GROUP BY provider,model,period)
